title: Left adjoint for the fixed universe-enlarged Hom functor
statement:
theorem gabriel_popescu_large_hom_isRightAdjoint
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vH} (DerivedCategory A)]
    (G : ShrinkHoms A) :
    ((ShrinkHoms.equivalence.{w} A).functor ⋙ preadditiveCoyonedaObj G ⋙
      ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{vH, w} (End G)ᵐᵒᵖ).IsRightAdjoint

source.place: Lemma 19.14.1, second proof: free presentation and cokernel construction; universe extension from the original abelian-core node large-coproduct step

proof.text: Transfer the displayed derived coproducts to A, shrink the index universe to max(w,vH), and transport them along ShrinkHoms.equivalence.

Remove the initial equivalence with Functor.isRightAdjoint_comp_iff_right. The Hom functor and module lift preserve w-sized limits, and ShrinkHoms A has w-sized limits by its Grothendieck structure. Apply the general adjoint-functor theorem to the w-small solution set for the enlarged Hom functor.
